$comment: google-auth: token requests the code makes itself on credentials whose kind tells the endpoint. Service account and user credentials (`service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_file(...)`, `google.oauth2.credentials.Credentials.from_authorized_user_file(...)`) ask Google's OAuth 2.0 token endpoint on `refresh(Request())`; `id_token.verify_oauth2_token` / `verify_token` / `verify_firebase_token` fetch Google's public certificates. Credentials from `google.auth.default()` are picked at run time (a metadata server, a key file): their refresh is not listed, nor are the refreshes other clients make implicitly.
